meta.name: CampusPulse — Smart Campus Analytics (KPMG Hackathon Build)
meta.one_line_goal: Ingest messy campus data (LMS, attendance, assessments, placement, feedback), enrich it with an explainable, CI-audited deterministic AI layer, and surface a ranked, humane advisor action list so faculty act on student success — not just watch it.

challenge.brief: Smart Campus Analytics: Predict, Optimize & Improve Student Success
